about_title: Long-term investing is a skill. I teach it.
about_text:
I'm Lenny Winnemuller, based in Amsterdam. I graduated with honors in psychology from the University of Amsterdam, specializing in group behavior, and also hold a degree in entrepreneurship. I've worked as a professional in the financial markets in the Netherlands and Canada, and today I invest independently.

I also teach long-term investing in a Canadian trader education program.
updates_title: A weekly note for long-term investors
updates_intro: Every week a short update on what moved the markets and what it means for long-term investors. No tips, no predictions, no advice.
